hits.snippet: Round — Lead investor — FriskAI Inc., a runtime intelligence startup, has raised $3.6 million in a seed funding round led by MaC Venture Capital Management. The funding aims to bolster the company's development of a platform that provides enterprises with detailed records of their artificial intelligence (AI) agents' activities once deployed. The platform is positioned to address a critical gap in understanding and managing AI agents, which, unlike conventional software, can operate with a degree of unpredictability when subjected to varying inputs or objectives. The funds will be directed towards expanding FriskAI's engineering team, enhancing market reach, and refining its behavioral analysis capabilities. Additionally, the company plans to accelerate customer deployments.
